text:
Lina: FYI  PraxisLab trial is blocked during onboarding: their admin can't create the initial workspace because our billing API returns a 402 with 'payment_required'. Support opened SUP-10444. They have a renewal touchpoint next week, tagging as priority.
Carlos: can you paste the error and number of affected seats?
Lina: log snippet: 
```
2026-04-10T09:13:02Z ERROR subscription.create status=402 body={\"error\":\"payment_required\",\"reason\":\"missing_payment_method\"}
```
Lina: happened for the first two seats; they can't finish onboarding or invite teammates.
Maya: last night we enabled a stricter fraud check that blocks accounts without a verified payment method. PraxisLab used a third-party billing proxy that doesn't send the verification flag.
Eli: mitigation options: A) temporarily relax fraud check for tenant=praxislab for 24h, or B) ask them to add a verified card now (might be slow). Which do they prefer?
Lina: customer asked for fastest unblock. They said theyd add a card if we can finish onboarding immediately.
Carlos: I can flip a tenant-level compat flag to accept proxy payment verifications for 24h and add audit logs. Do it and I'll notify them.
NotifyBot: feature.toggle.payment_proxy_toleration set=true for tenant=praxislab (by Carlos)
Carlos: toggled. Lina - ask them to retry onboarding.
Lina: PraxisLab retried and onboarding completed. They attached billing after we walked them through adding a card. :white_check_mark:
Maya: plan: release a compatibility patch to accept proxy verification headers and add a unit test for the proxy flow. ETA 2026-04-11 10:30 PT. Ill own the fix and rollback.
Carlos: draft comms (non-technical): \"Hi Jordan  were sorry for the onboarding interruption. We applied a temporary change to allow your billing to complete while we finish a permanent fix. Our engineers will deploy a patch tomorrow and well follow up when its live. Wed also like to offer a one-time pro-rated credit for the inconvenience and a 30-minute setup walkthrough.  Carlos, Customer Success\"
Eli: LGTM; remove internal toggle names before sending. Finance ok with small credit.
Lina: sent comms and calendar invite to Jordan + eng contact; SUP-10444 link added. Customer replied: \"Thanks  were unblocked and can join the call tomorrow. Appreciate the quick help.\"
Carlos: tracking: 1) Patch payment-proxy compatibility (Maya) ETA 2026-04-11 10:30 PT, 2) Rollback temp toleration after verification (Maya), 3) Post-patch follow-up (Carlos), 4) Walkthrough (Lina).
Maya: will post release notes and flip the flag off after checks.
Lina: closing support ticket as verified. Account health: at-risk -> recovering. Marking renewal status: priority outreach until post-patch confirmation. Thanks team :handshake:
